contents.content:
Do you long to get away from the rush of Bangalore city life in a peaceful manner? No need to search any further! This post will discuss the top resorts that allow pets close to Bangalore so that you two may relax, have fun, and make lifelong memories. These beautiful retreats include everything your pet could possibly need for a wag-tastic trip, from comfortable cottages to lush gardens.

Table of Contents

Pet-friendly VAMA Retreats is located at the heart of Nandi Hills, about a half-hour's drive from Bengaluru Airport. Here, you can spoil your furry friends and give them the vacation they deserve. Your dog will love the dog pool, which is situated amid a 180-acre green campus with lakes, vineyards, forests, organic farms, and expansive lawns. Your pet will also love the open air pool.

Address-Survey Number 27-1, Canterbury Castles Layout, Oodanahalli, Acharlahalli, Karnataka 561205.

Away from the hustle and bustle of the city, you might discover tranquility at Holiday Village Resort. With your entire family, including your beloved pet, you may unwind and enjoy some quality time here. This pet-friendly resort in Bangalore is set on a sizable property with lovely trees all around, offering a tranquil environment and enough of fresh air to awaken your senses. Cozying up with your pet is made possible by the spacious, cozy areas. To beat the summer heat, cool yourself in one of the lovely swimming pools. Savor mouthwatering meals that are served buffet-style and will satisfy your appetite for more.

Address-35, 9th Mile, Holiday Village Road Kanakapura, Road, Vajarahalli Village, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560062.

Located between the bustling international airport and the breathtaking Nandi Hills  is the amazing JW Marriott Hotel Bengaluru Prestige Golfshire Resort & Spa. You and your animal companion will be treated like royalty there. This pet-friendly resort in Bangalore has all the amenities needed to keep your pet happy on a day trip.Imagine them delighting in the beautiful surroundings and warm weather as they stroll around the beautiful golf course. They can even playfully splash around in the beautiful outdoor pool, putting a smile to everyone's smile.

Address: Nandi Hills Road Karahalli Post, Kundana Hobli, Taluk, Devanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 562164.

Located in Bangalore's quiet suburbs, the Rustic Village Farmhouse is well-known for its friendly staff and top-notch amenities. Their first goal is to supply pets with delicious and wholesome meals. Both of you will enjoy a peaceful getaway, and your pet will feel warmly welcomed.

Address: J9FG+4C3, Chikka Mudhawadi, Karnataka 562117.

In Sakleshpur, the hotel is a dog- and human-friendly paradise. If your pet is the social type, they are going to have a great time at the homestay since they have their own dog companions. The 10-acre property where the hotel is situated has six different cabins to select from. The rooms are roomy and furnished with standard amenities for comfort. You can savor home-cooked meals prepared by the host at the homestay.

Address: Bugadahalli Village,kyanahalli post, Sakleshpura, Karnataka 573134

Make a Plan:Find out which eateries, lodging facilities, and tourism destinations accept pets. Bring together everything your pet might need, including food, water, bedding, and any prescribed medicines.

Visit the Vet: Before leaving, make sure your pet is healthy and up to date on their vaccines by having them examined by a veterinarian. Obtain any health certifications or paperwork that are needed, especially for international or air travel.

Assure Safety: Depending on the mode of transportation, keep your pet safe throughout travel in a well-ventilated carrier, kennel, or safety harness. Your pet should be able to comfortably stand, turn, and lay down in the carrier.

Pack Essentials: Bring ample food, water, treats, and familiar items like toys or blankets for comfort. Don’t forget waste bags, a leash, a collar with ID tags, and any grooming supplies.

Take Breaks and Exercise: Plan frequent breaks on long journeys so your pet can stretch, relieve themselves, and get some exercise. Along your way, look for parks or rest places that allow pets so your pet may play and get some fresh air.

excerpt: Discover the best pet-friendly resorts near Bangalore for a perfect getaway with your furry friends, offering welcoming accommodations and amenities for all.
